subject: general
question: Where, in India, would you find rock paintings dating back to the stone age?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhimbetka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhimbetka Caves: **

 
 
• These are a group of more than 750 rock shelters in the state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• They are known for their ancient rock paintings, which provide insights into the lives of early humans in India.
 
• The paintings depict hunting scenes, animals, and religious motifs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nalanda Caves:**

 
 
• Located in the state of Bihar, these caves are associated with the ancient Nalanda University, a renowned center of learning.
 
• The caves were used by Buddhist monks as places of meditation and study.
 
 
 
• **Bagh Caves:**
 
 
• Situated in the state of Madhya Pradesh, these caves are famous for their intricate mural paintings.
 
• The paintings depict scenes from Buddhist mythology and are considered to be some of the finest examples of ancient Indian art.
 
 
 
• **Elephanta Caves: **
 
 
• These are a group of cave temples dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva, located on an island off the coast of Mumbai.
 
• The caves are known for their impressive sculptures, including a large tri-headed statue of Shiva.
